description: This plot illustrates the relationship between "Sample Token Count" and "Shared Experts for Two Samples" across six different categories. The x-axis represents the "Sample Token Count" on a logarithmic scale (base 2), ranging from $2^9$ to $2^{20}$ with tick marks at every power of 2. The y-axis represents "Shared Experts for Two Samples" on a linear scale, ranging from 2.0 to 6.0 with tick intervals of 0.5. All six categories are represented by solid lines without markers. The "Intent" category, shown as a solid orange line, begins at approximately 3.75 at $2^9$, experiences a decline to roughly 3.9 at $2^{11}$, and then generally increases to reach 6.0 at $2^{19}$, remaining steady at 6.0 at $2^{20}$. The "Summary" category, depicted by a solid blue line, starts at approximately 1.9 at $2^9$, rises sharply before dipping to 4.5 at $2^{12}$, and then climbs steadily to end at approximately 5.95 at $2^{20}$. The "Law" category, represented by a solid yellow line, starts at roughly 3.6 at $2^9$, peaks at approximately 5.8 at $2^{14}$, declines to 5.5 at $2^{15}$, and subsequently rises to end near 6.0 at $2^{20}$. The "Translation" category, shown as a solid purple line, begins at approximately 5.1 at $2^9$, drops to 4.7 at $2^{11}$, and then follows a generally upward trend to finish at approximately 5.9 at $2^{20}$. The "Code" category, indicated by a solid grey line, starts at approximately 1.9 at $2^9$, exhibits a peak of 3.7 at $2^{13}$ followed by a drop to 3.1 at $2^{14}$, and then rises to end at approximately 5.8 at $2^{20}$. Finally, the "Math" category, represented by a solid green line, starts at approximately 3.8 at $2^9$, rises steadily to 5.9 at $2^{18}$, dips slightly to 5.85 at $2^{19}$, and concludes at approximately 5.95 at $2^{20}$.
